name: OpenRouter
description: Unified gateway to 200+ LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral) via a single OpenAI-compatible API.
postInstallNotes:
1. Browse 200+ models at openrouter.ai/models — use the model ID as the `model` parameter.
2. Example models: `openai/gpt-4o`, `anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet`, `meta-llama/llama-3.1-70b-instruct`.
3. OpenRouter uses pay-as-you-go pricing per model — no separate API key per provider needed.
